newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: horse racing-Extra race-fixture at Tipperary announced.
newsitem.headline: horse racing-Extra race-fixture at Tipperary announced.

text.p: The Irish Horseracing Authority said on Friday its Fixtures Committee had approved the staging of an extra race-fixture at Tipperary racecourse on Friday, November 15.
The IHA said in a statement that the race card would be mixed, consisting of four flat and three national hunt races.
This added fixture gives Kevin Manning a boost in his efforts to overhaul reigning champion Johnny Murtagh in the battle for the flat jockey's championship.
Manning currently trails Murtagh, who left Ireland to winter in Hong Kong on Tuesday, by two winners in the championship.
